task: Detect Floquet-Bloch replica bands of the Dirac cone in monolayer epitaxial graphene with 5 um MIR (ℏω=0.248 eV) tr-ARPES; characterize FB <-> Volkov scattering via pump polarization dependence.
named_methods: Floquet-Bloch state identification via energy- and momentum-resolved replicas spaced by ℏω
Volkov final-state (laser-assisted photoemission, LAPE) interpretation of the photon-dressed final state
Polarization-angle dependence I(θ_p) of replica intensity to disentangle Floquet-Bloch vs Volkov contributions
primary_observables: Replica band positions (n=±1) and their energy offset relative to the n=0 Dirac cone
Replica intensity as a function of pump polarization angle θ_p
Time-delay dependence of replica intensity (transient nature)
expected_signatures: Replica bands offset by ±ℏω = ±0.248 eV from the equilibrium Dirac cone
Replicas only present when pump and probe overlap in time
Polarization angular pattern characteristic of FB-Volkov interference (period 90° for cos(4θ_p)) or pure FB (≈ isotropic) or pure Volkov (cos²(θ_p) with 180° period)

validation_against_related_work.paper_000: Oka & Aoki 2009 — theoretical Floquet treatment of graphene under intense AC field; predicts photoinduced gap.
validation_against_related_work.paper_001: Wang et al., Science 2013 — direct ARPES observation of FB on Bi2Se3 surface, established methodology and Volkov/LAPE distinction.
validation_against_related_work.paper_002: Hübener et al. — Floquet-Weyl semimetal theory.
validation_against_related_work.paper_003: Sentef et al. 2015 — pump-probe theory of Floquet bands in graphene with realistic pulses.
